documentation_excerpts.text: Decide whether an AI agent skill is safe to install, keep installed, or submit for review.
1. SkillSpector static evidence: deterministic scanning for known risk patterns. 2. Agent semantic review: source-aware judgment about intent, permission fit, hidden behavior, and user control.
Do not rely on the numeric score alone. A low score can miss semantic risk, and a high score can be justified when sensitive behavior is clearly documented, necessary, and bounded.
